reason: The plugin is primarily an image-to-text utility for DeepSeek Harness, enabling users to paste screenshots or provide local JPEG/PNG/WEBP files so the chat model can answer questions about image content; evidence in the README and package manifest consistently identifies MindSee as the external backend and web-client plugin integration.

summaries.zh: MindSee 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可将粘贴截图或本地图片转换为文字描述，让 DeepSeek 在对话中基于图片内容作答。
summaries.en: MindSee is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that converts pasted screenshots or local images into text so DeepSeek can respond to questions about image content.

capabilities: Describe pasted or local images via MindSee for use in DeepSeek conversations
Support for JPEG, PNG, and WebP image input in web chat flow
Read configured plugin credential/token for external service access
Operate as a DeepSeek Harness web plugin extension

reasons.code: Plugin purpose and flow describe screenshots/local images being converted into descriptions for model use
Uses MindSee as the backend service for image description, indicating external service integration
Requires user to create and configure a MindSee access token in plugin settings
Manifest indicates web platform client injection and plugin packaging for DeepSeek Harness
